# Second-quarter and half-year results 2026

Aker Solutions delivered solid financial performance in the second quarter and the first half of
2026. Several key project milestones were met during the quarter. Aker Solutions now expects 2026
revenue to be between NOK 50 and 55 billion with EBITDA margins of around 7.5 percent excluding net
profit from SLB OneSubsea.
[Read more][2]

# Aker Solutions secures contract with Tussa Energi for Tussa II hydropower plant

Aker Solutions has secured a sizeable[1] contract with Tussa Energi to supply all electromechanical
equipment for the Tussa II hydropower plant, located in the Volda region of western Norway.
[Read more][3]

# Aker Solutions awarded Engineering and Maintenance Service agreement from Cenovus Energy

Aker Solutions has signed a sizeable¹ five-year agreement with Cenovus Energy Inc. for engineering
and maintenance services on White Rose field assets. 
[Read more][4]

# Aker Solutions wins FEED-contract for Equinor’s Atlantis tie-in

Aker Solutions has been awarded a front-end engineering and design (FEED) contract by Equinor to
prepare the Kvitebjørn platform for production from the Atlantis subsea tie-in project.
[Read more][5]

# First-quarter results 2026

Aker Solutions has delivered solid financial results as revenues normalize from peak levels in 2025.
The company recorded an order intake in the first quarter of NOK 28.8 billion, lifting the secured
order backlog to NOK 80.2 billion at quarter-end. Revenue in 2026 is expected to be around NOK 50
billion with EBITDA-margins excluding net income from SLB OneSubsea in the range of 7.0 to 7.5
percent. In April, the Annual General Meeting approved the total distribution of NOK 8.60 per share
in ordinary and extraordinary dividends, which was paid to shareholders on April 27, 2026.
[Read more][6]

# Aker Solutions signs MOU with Rolls-Royce SMR for small modular reactor energy projects

Aker Solutions AS has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Rolls-Royce SMR Ltd within the
small modular reactor (SMR) market. The MoU establishes a partnership to develop Aker Solutions’
offering of non-nuclear parts of framed modules for Rolls-Royce SMR’s portfolio, leveraging Aker
Solutions’ deep expertise in modularization and complex energy project execution.
[Read more][7]
[picture of aker solution logo on a wall]

# Aker Solutions wins FEED contract for CO₂ terminal in Lithuania

Aker Solutions has been awarded a front-end engineering and design (FEED) contract by KN Energies to
support the development of the company’s CO₂ transshipment terminal infrastructure project in
Klaipėda, Lithuania.
[Read about the Klaipėda CO2 terminal][8]

# Aker Solutions awarded long-term MMO frame agreement by Aker BP

Aker Solutions has been awarded a major[1] five-year contract with Aker BP for Maintenance,
Modification and Operation services (MMO). The contract covers all Aker BP’s key assets on the
Norwegian Continental Shelf, including the new Yggdrasil area.
[Read more][9]
[Photo of Aker BP's Valhall platform ]

# Fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results

Aker Solutions delivered solid financial results in a period of record-high activity and intends to
pay out dividends of NOK 3.60 per share for 2025.
[Read more][10]

# Aker Solutions secures long-term maintenance and modifications frame agreements with Equinor

Aker Solutions has been awarded multiple five-year frame agreements with Equinor. Under the
agreements, Aker Solutions will provide maintenance and modifications services for a range of assets
on the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS) and onshore Norway.
[Read more][11]

# Aker Solutions awarded substantial M&M contract by ConocoPhillips

Aker Solutions has signed a six-year frame agreement with ConocoPhillips Skandinavia AS
(ConocoPhillips), which includes an option to extend the contract for up to two additional
three-year periods. 
[Read more][12]
[picture of Aker Solution workers on Ekofisk]

# Aker Solutions secures significant brownfield services contract from ExxonMobil Canada

Aker Solutions has signed a five-year enabling contract with ExxonMobil Canada Properties, a
partnership, as operator of the Hebron platform. The contract is an extension for brownfield
maintenance and modification (M&M) services on the Hebron platform.
[Read more][13]
[picture of aker solution logo on a wall]

# Automation Solutions for High-Stakes Operations

Emerson’s automation solutions help you unlock critical data, optimize your existing systems and
protect the investments you’ve already made.

## Emerson's Automation Solutions Optimize Performance

Emerson empowers you to modernize business operations at your pace, drive optimal performance and
deliver long-term operational excellence.

[icon]

##### Unrivaled Industrial Software

From control systems to industrial software, our advanced automation solutions power connected
operations and improve performance where it matters most.

[icon]

##### Global Support Network

Emerson’s global support and local experts offer deep market knowledge that minimizes business
disruption and keeps industrial operations running. 

[icon]

##### Proven Industry Expertise

Emerson brings decades of technical expertise and industry insight to solve the world’s most complex
operational challenges.

[icon]

##### Legacy of Innovations

Built on 135+ years of innovation, Emerson technologies and solutions are shaping the future of

[Multiple gas storage tanks are lined up, showcasing safety ladders and railings for secure access.]

## Expertise earned over a century.

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real
consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing
safety on site.]

## Intelligence set in motion.

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we
harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that
continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes

## Our expertise

Whatever your needs, our technical experts are here to help. We mobilise our rich heritage in core
markets, apply innovation and pursue excellence to solve today's challenges and equip you for
tomorrow's.

### 01 Buildings

Whether you’re in the public or private sector, we can support your project – we work across a broad
range of building types including arts and culture, aviation and ports, commercial, retail and
offices, education, healthcare, local and central government, residential and hotels, sports and
events venues, and transport buildings. 

[Our work in the Buildings market][135]

### 02 Defence and security

We are proud to be a trusted partner for some of the most complex and critical defence and security
equipment and infrastructure programmes worldwide, giving our clients what they need to be
operationally ready and effective. 

[Our work in the Defence and security market][136]

### 03 Energy

We understand energy markets and the different paces of transition. We’ll use our unique breadth of
energy sector technical expertise to co-create solutions with you, and help you deliver them.

[Our work in the Energy market][137]

### 04 Environment and society

Our global network of climate, environment and social experts support clients and project teams to
achieve: sustainability throughout the project lifecycle, a strong reputation with investors and
stakeholders, and innovative, cost-effective solutions.

[Our work in the Environment and society market][138]

### 05 Transport

Effective development and delivery of transport infrastructure is essential to realise the benefits
from efficient and sustainable transport networks. Leveraging our global expertise in urban,
suburban, and rural environments, our experts help clients create solutions that are intuitive and
safe to use – and that maximise wider social, health and environmental outcomes.  

[Our work in the Transport market][139]

### 06 Water

We have more than a century of water management experience and have played leading roles in many of
the world’s largest and most transformative water supply, wastewater, irrigation, drainage, and
flood protection projects. 

[Our work in the Water market][140]

North America

transport.

### Engineering natural processes to pre-treat water

By providing preliminary – and entirely biological – water treatment, 31 new floating wetlands are
key to bringing an abandoned water resource back into use.

Asia

The largest privately financed offshore wind energy project in Japan provides a model for others to

### Digital innovation is enhancing the observational method on HS2

UK

The observational method often delivers dramatic time, cost and safety benefits – but even these can
be greatly enhanced with DAARWIN, a new software solution that employs machine learning.

][119] [

### Climate Change Support Programme, Nepal

Asia

A UK aid funded programme is helping communities to adapt by providing technical know-how and
financial aid to climate resilience projects and strengthening government financial, planning and
governance systems.

During large storm events, the Cohocksink sewer system in Philadelphia can become overwhelmed,
causing basements and streets to flood. Now, a US$93.5M project to double sewer capacity is nearing
completion.

The UK government’s target for making the energy system greener, more diverse and more resilient
requires an ambitious programme of wind farm construction, alongside new transmission
infrastructure.

under a combination of two large public-private partnerships and two progressive design-build
contracts.

Markets

## Our expertise

Whatever your needs, our technical experts are here to help. We mobilise our rich heritage in core
markets, apply innovation and pursue excellence to solve today's challenges and equip you for
tomorrow's.

### 01 Buildings

Whether you’re in the public or private sector, we can support your project – we work across a broad
range of building types including arts and culture, aviation and ports, commercial, retail and
offices, education, healthcare, local and central government, residential and hotels, sports and
events venues, and transport buildings. 

[Our work in the Buildings market][135]

### 02 Defence and security

We are proud to be a trusted partner for some of the most complex and critical defence and security
equipment and infrastructure programmes worldwide, giving our clients what they need to be
operationally ready and effective. 

[Our work in the Defence and security market][136]

### 03 Energy

We understand energy markets and the different paces of transition. We’ll use our unique breadth of
energy sector technical expertise to co-create solutions with you, and help you deliver them.

[Our work in the Energy market][137]

### 04 Environment and society

Our global network of climate, environment and social experts support clients and project teams to
achieve: sustainability throughout the project lifecycle, a strong reputation with investors and
stakeholders, and innovative, cost-effective solutions.

[Our work in the Environment and society market][138]

### 05 Transport

Effective development and delivery of transport infrastructure is essential to realise the benefits
from efficient and sustainable transport networks. Leveraging our global expertise in urban,
suburban, and rural environments, our experts help clients create solutions that are intuitive and
safe to use – and that maximise wider social, health and environmental outcomes.  

[Our work in the Transport market][139]

### 06 Water

We have more than a century of water management experience and have played leading roles in many of
the world’s largest and most transformative water supply, wastewater, irrigation, drainage, and
flood protection projects. 

[Our work in the Water market][140]

### About Suez

[Who we are][100]
[Sustainable development][101]

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.

microprocessor-based applications, telecommunications, data storage and delivery, computer products,
instrumentation and security systems.  We are well known for:
* Worldwide Support and Customer Service
* Flexible and High-Quality Manufacturing
* Reliable Products and Technical Expertise

# Take Control with Automatic Tank Dewatering with the id-200

Engineered for precision, our automatic dewatering solutions remove water from storage tanks safely
and efficiently. Designed for fuel depots, oil refineries, and industrial sites requiring
dependable, maintenance-free performance.

**Engineered for Accuracy**

#### Our Tank Dewatering is a breakthrough technology that ensures the highest accuracy, down to low
#### ppm levels, effectively eliminating the loss of hydrocarbons in the water draw-off line.

Experience superior separation with the ID-200h Automatic Oil Tank Dewatering and Desalter system.
Our advanced interface detection technology ensures precise control and measurement in various
liquid/liquid separation processes. The ID-200h enhances operational efficiency, reduces
cross-contamination, and optimizes chemical usage. Trust in reliable, state-of-the-art solutions for
your dewatering and desalting needs.

Trusted by some of the best in the industry

### The waste and cost of slop oil.

With crude oil under $100/bbl and poor oil and water interface/separation control, refineries
accidentally dump crude oil and/or refined products into the wastewater treatment system regularly.
The oil is not lost but is recovered in the wwts/api separator. However, it is no longer virgin
crude oil or refined product – the lights have evaporated, and the product has been sheared and
emulsified by pumps & contaminated with solids. In effect, it has been reduced to recovered slop
oil. The [ID200][15] is the perfect solution to automatic tank dewatering.

A typical refinery today will accidentally dump 0.5% to 1.0% of its total throughput to the water
treatment systems because of poor interface/separation control. For a 100,000bpd refinery, this
equals 500 to 1,000bpd of recovered slop oil.

**ID200h Series **Enhanced Connectivity and Power Efficiency

Sensor features

The ID200h Series stands out with its 2 Wire loop-powered system and HART communication protocol,
offering seamless integration and [enhanced energy][16] efficiency. It is ideal for sophisticated
control systems requiring advanced communication capabilities.

A hight-frequency, low-power energy is broadcast.

The detection range is a 3″ sphere around the tip.

Some of the energy is absorbed by the medium surrounding the antenna.

The analogue signal is generated relative to the absorption rate.

### Cutting-edge innovation converges with unparalleled performance.

### Technology

The Agar [ID-200 Series Interface][17] Detectors are a cornerstone in automatic tank dewatering and
separation processes. These detectors, crafted from robust 316 stainless steel and available in
specialized materials like duplex and hastalloy, are designed for precision in challenging
environments. They excel in high-pressure scenarios up to 3000 PSI and can withstand a broad
temperature range from- 40°F to 185°F (-40 °C to 85°C). The ID200h Series further enhances this
lineup with its 2 Wire Loop Powered system and HART communication, ensuring efficient operation and
seamless integration in advanced c[ontrol systems][18]. Ideal for various industrial applications,
the ID-200 Series is a testament to innovation in automatic tank dewatering and liquid/liquid
separation [technology][19].

#### Our Tank Dewatering is a breakthrough technology that ensures the highest accuracy, down to low
#### ppm levels, effectively eliminating the loss of hydrocarbons in the water draw-off line.

Experience superior separation with the ID-200h Automatic Oil Tank Dewatering and Desalter system.
Our advanced interface detection technology ensures precise control and measurement in various
liquid/liquid separation processes. The ID-200h enhances operational efficiency, reduces
cross-contamination, and optimizes chemical usage. Trust in reliable, state-of-the-art solutions for
your dewatering and desalting needs.

#### **Precision Interface Detection**

Explore the ID-200H’s advanced capabilities in delivering accurate oil-water interface detection.

#### ********Durability in Diverse Conditions********

Learn about the ID-200H’s durability and adaptability across diverse operational environments.

#### ********Leading ****Control and Automation************

Discover how the ID-200H enhances automated processes for efficient dewatering and desalting.

# Automatic Tank Dewatering

# & Desalter

**Engineered for Precision**

### **See the ID-200 in Action**

[Request Demo][14]

Discover how precision interface detection can cut losses, boost efficiency, and deliver real
results, whatever your operation.

Trusted by some of the best in the industry

### The waste and cost of slop oil.

With crude oil under $100/bbl and poor oil and water interface/separation control, refineries
accidentally dump crude oil and/or refined products into the wastewater treatment system regularly.
The oil is not lost but is recovered in the wwts/api separator. However, it is no longer virgin
crude oil or refined product – the lights have evaporated, and the product has been sheared and
emulsified by pumps & contaminated with solids. In effect, it has been reduced to recovered slop
oil. The [ID200][15] is the perfect solution to automatic tank dewatering.

A typical refinery today will accidentally dump 0.5% to 1.0% of its total throughput to the water
treatment systems because of poor interface/separation control. For a 100,000bpd refinery, this
equals 500 to 1,000bpd of recovered slop oil.

**ID200h Series **Enhanced Connectivity and Power Efficiency

Sensor features

The ID200h Series stands out with its 2 Wire loop-powered system and HART communication protocol,
offering seamless integration and [enhanced energy][16] efficiency. It is ideal for sophisticated
control systems requiring advanced communication capabilities.

A hight-frequency, low-power energy is broadcast.

The detection range is a 3″ sphere around the tip.

Some of the energy is absorbed by the medium surrounding the antenna.

The analogue signal is generated relative to the absorption rate.

### Cutting-edge innovation converges with unparalleled performance.

### Technology

The Agar [ID-200 Series Interface][17] Detectors are a cornerstone in automatic tank dewatering and
separation processes. These detectors, crafted from robust 316 stainless steel and available in
specialized materials like duplex and hastalloy, are designed for precision in challenging
environments. They excel in high-pressure scenarios up to 3000 PSI and can withstand a broad
temperature range from- 40°F to 185°F (-40 °C to 85°C). The ID200h Series further enhances this
lineup with its 2 Wire Loop Powered system and HART communication, ensuring efficient operation and
seamless integration in advanced c[ontrol systems][18]. Ideal for various industrial applications,
the ID-200 Series is a testament to innovation in automatic tank dewatering and liquid/liquid
separation [technology][19].

Unlock Precision in Oil in Water Analysis

Discover the TD-550 and TD-560 Oil in Water Analysers – advanced, portable solutions utilizing
cutting-edge UV fluorescence technology. Achieve quick, accurate, and reliable measurements for a
wide range of hydrocarbons in water. Click here to explore their features and benefits.

[Find out more][20]

### The ID-200 Series Interface Detector in action.

Dive into the world of precision process control with our exclusive photo gallery of the Agar ID-200
Series Interface Detectors. From the sleek stainless steel build to the advanced technological
features, our gallery offers a closer look at what makes the ID-200 a leader in automatic tank
dewatering and liquid separation processes. See why it’s the preferred choice for industry
professionals.

## Case Studies

### Nuclear Asset and Confined Space Inspections

Learn how Dominion Energy uses ROVs to inspect submerged nuclear assets, reduce radiation exposure,
avoid diver entry, and collect repeatable inspection data.
[Read More on Nuclear Asset Inspections][100]
[underwater rov, underwater inspection, offshore inspection, offshore operations, oil and gas,
offshore platform, rov, work class rov, inspection class rov]

### Innovative Offshore Inspections

Learn how Frontier deployed a PIVOT ROV from a work-class ROV to inspect a small pipe in a
challenging offshore splash zone, demonstrating a repeatable approach for inspecting open-ended
subsea piping where direct access is limited.
[Read More on Innovative Offshore Integrations][101]
[undp]

### Ukraine’s Underwater Demining Efforts

Learn how UNDP is strengthening Ukraine’s underwater demining program through targeted ROV training,
integration of marine inspection technologies, and the development of coordinated subsea workflows.

# Modular Packages & Process Technology Support

Skid-mounted process units, crude oil treatment systems, gas processing packages, PSA/TSA adsorption
units, sweetening, incineration, and flare gas recovery — backed by real process engineering
expertise.

[View Products & Solutions][6] [Discuss Your Project][7]

## About Shanghai IPS Process Technologies

Shanghai IPS Process Technologies is an engineering and fabrication company focused on modular,
skid-mounted solutions for the oil, gas, petrochemical, and specialty chemical industries. We design
and build practical, field-ready packages that reduce site construction, shorten project schedules,
and improve operational reliability.

Our core offering combines two strengths: **complete modular packages** (crude oil dehydrators and
desalters, separation skids, pumping units, refrigeration packages, PSA/TSA adsorption units, amine
sweetening, incinerator systems, flare gas recovery packages) and **process technology support**
across key refining and petrochemical technologies. This combination allows IPS to deliver solutions
that are not only mechanically sound, but also process-correct and optimized for real operating
conditions.

IPS also supports clients with rental units, rebuilt and refurbished packages, and relocation of
existing plants, including dismantling, refurbishment, and re-certification for new service.

## Integrated Modular Solutions & Technology Support

IPS is not just a fabrication contractor. We integrate process engineering, modular design, and
practical execution into a single offering. This allows us to support clients from early concept
definition through to hardware delivery and start-up.
* **Modular & Skid-Mounted Packages:** Crude oil dehydrators and desalters, separation packages, gas
  dehydration (TEG and molecular sieve), PSA/TSA adsorption units, refrigeration and dew point
  control packages, gas sweetening units, incinerators, and flare gas recovery systems.
* **Process Engineering & Technology Support:** Support for PDH, MTO, LAB, FCC, hydrocracking,
  hydrotreating, base oil technologies, and fatty acid/fatty alcohol production, including
  evaluation, revamps, and debottlenecking.
* **Rental & Temporary Units:** Test separators, crude treating units, filtration and conditioning
  skids, temporary dehydration and sweetening units for commissioning and short-term production.
* **Rebuilt & Relocated Plants:** Dismantling, relocation, upgrade, and conversion of used plants
  and equipment into engineered modular packages with a new design life.

This combination of hardware and technology capability is a key advantage of IPS and allows us to
deliver solutions that are practical, buildable, and technically robust.

## Process Technologies Support

IPS provides process engineering and technology support for a wide range of refining and
petrochemical units. We help clients evaluate new projects, revamp existing units, and solve
performance and reliability issues.
* **PDH – Propane Dehydrogenation:** Reactor and regenerator performance review, catalyst
  evaluation, energy and heat integration studies.
* **MTO – Methanol to Olefins:** Reactor system evaluation, catalyst selection, integration with
  downstream polymer or olefin units.
* **LAB – Linear Alkyl Benzene:** Alkylation and dehydrogenation unit support, purification
  optimization, capacity and quality improvements.
* **FCC – Fluid Catalytic Cracking:** Reactor/regenerator optimization, riser operation, catalyst
  circulation, and heat balance checks.
* **Hydrocracking Units:** Catalyst grading, reactor configuration, hydrogen management, product
  slate optimization, and revamp concept development.
* **Hydrotreating Units:** Naphtha, diesel, VGO, kerosene, and lube oil hydrotreaters, including
  kinetics evaluation, catalyst loading schemes, and flexibility studies.
* **Base Oil Group II & III:** Hydroprocessing, isodewaxing, dewaxing, and finishing section
  improvement for high-quality base oils.
* **Fatty Acid & Fatty Alcohol Production:** Process support for splitting, esterification,
  hydrogenation, distillation, and product quality control.

By combining this process technology experience with in-house modular design and fabrication, IPS
can offer clients both engineering guidance and deliverable equipment, instead of isolated studies
or generic packages.

## Global Presence

IPS supports projects across multiple regions through a combination of engineering offices and
fabrication partners. This allows us to source competitively, fabricate near key markets, and
coordinate international logistics.
* **Offices:** Shanghai, China  |  Toronto, Canada  |  Dubai, UAE
* **Fabrication Facilities:** Sharjah, UAE  |  Shanghai, China

* **Modular & Skid-Mounted Focus:** Designs are optimized for minimum field work, shorter shutdowns,

* **Technology-Backed Packages:** Our packages are supported by real know-how in PDH, MTO, LAB, FCC,

# Providing Industrial, Commercial and Domestic Water Treatment Solutions !!

### As a leading water treatment manufacturer in Australia and the South Pacific we understand many
### of the complexities of water and its many associated problems and behaviors for our vast range
### of customers.

### Our vast expertise and knowledge of advanced membrane technology can solve the toughest types of
### water problems from utilising ultra-filtration and advanced desalination membranes to full blown
### clarification and biological treatment plants to renovate, rectify and upgrade water.
### In fact, our waste water systems are so finely equipped that they ease the industrial procession
### of water, the control of water pollution and the purification of waste water.

# PUMP SYSTEM

## Peristaltic Pump Delivers Lime Slurry to Water Treatment Plant with Unprecedented Reliability.
## Offering Convenience

# We Design & Service  – Remote Mining Camp Water & Waste Water Systems

Origin Water provides turnkey solution packages for remote camps providing piece of mind for the end
user.  Plants are designed and built in Australia to suit the harsh conditions that are normally
encountered at remote sites.

Origin Water understands the needs and environmental impacts of sites and all plants that are built
are backed by qualified service personal and 24/7 monitoring to ensure the plants provide years of
reliable trouble free operation,
* Modular turnkey water solutions for up to 5,000EP
* Modular turnkey waste water solutions up to 5,000EP
* Designed and manufactured in Australia

[read more][22]

# OEM Manufactured Products
* Ultra Filtration Skids – We have designed our own skid systems
* Reverse Osmosis Skids
* Containerised Water Solutions
* Demineralisation skid packages
* Electrical cabinets and PLC Programming
* HDPE Poly Fabrication

[read more][23]

# OUR CLIENT RANGE
* Clients want to add Water treatment to the list of products they sell
* Pumping and irrigation stores
* Mining
* Commercial plumbers
* Manufacturing Industry
* Chemical suppliers
* Power Stations
* Engineering consultants
* Remote accommodation companies

# What Our Clients Say !

*I recently employed the services of Origin Water in an audit on the ‘Lancewood Village Camp’ near
Moranbah. From the initial phone call through to the professionalism conveyed on site to my client
was outstanding. The audit was detailed with schematic drawings, photographic evidence with detailed
explanations with overlay descriptions to assist in communicating this through the channels of
business. The level of information explains why I had been told by colleagues to engage Origin Water
to help and review our systems on site and what could be done to ensure this critical operation of
STP and WTP are in correct working order at all times. *

*Origin Water will be used on many future mining projects to ensure sites are compliant, servicing
scheduling up to date, emergency call outs, refit and new STP and WTP systems for sites. *

***HEATH BETTS***

***Operations Manager***

***CATER CARE SERVICES PTY LTD***

# Providing Industrial, Commercial and Domestic Water Treatment Solutions !!

### As a leading water treatment manufacturer in Australia and the South Pacific we understand many
### of the complexities of water and its many associated problems and behaviors for our vast range
### of customers.

### Our vast expertise and knowledge of advanced membrane technology can solve the toughest types of
### water problems from utilising ultra-filtration and advanced desalination membranes to full blown
### clarification and biological treatment plants to renovate, rectify and upgrade water.
### In fact, our waste water systems are so finely equipped that they ease the industrial procession
### of water, the control of water pollution and the purification of waste water.

# We Design & Service  – Remote Mining Camp Water & Waste Water Systems

Origin Water provides turnkey solution packages for remote camps providing piece of mind for the end
user.  Plants are designed and built in Australia to suit the harsh conditions that are normally
encountered at remote sites.

Origin Water understands the needs and environmental impacts of sites and all plants that are built
are backed by qualified service personal and 24/7 monitoring to ensure the plants provide years of
reliable trouble free operation,
* Modular turnkey water solutions for up to 5,000EP
* Modular turnkey waste water solutions up to 5,000EP
* Designed and manufactured in Australia

*I recently employed the services of Origin Water in an audit on the ‘Lancewood Village Camp’ near

business. The level of information explains why I had been told by colleagues to engage Origin Water
to help and review our systems on site and what could be done to ensure this critical operation of
STP and WTP are in correct working order at all times. *

*Origin Water will be used on many future mining projects to ensure sites are compliant, servicing

###### WELCOME TO PETRECO

# World Leaders in High Performance Process Solutions

World leaders in high performance process solutions Petreco is one of the leading suppliers of
process technologies to a wide range of industries.
 
Our products are used in oil and gas production, refining, chemical and industrial processes.
 
We work worldwide with end users, contractors, and engineering consulting firms to solve complex
system design challenges for process equipment.

###### What We Do

##### Our Expertise

## Engineering Services

Design studies | Cost estimates | Process & mechanical design | Instrumentation & controls | CAD/3D
| PSM/HAZOP | Project & operator support

#### Manufacturing

Quality control management | Fabrication & assembly |
Factory testing | As-built documentation

#### Installation

Global logistics & reassembly | Site inspection & commissioning |
Start-up assistance

#### Solutions

Parts & service | Troubleshooting | Debottlenecking | Upgrades, revamps & retrofits

###### Industries We Serve

## Oil & Gas - Refining - Petrochemical - Industrial Manufacturing

##### Our technologies and expertise empower production across sectors where precision, reliability,
##### and efficiency are critical.

### Expertise

Decades of engineering experience.

### Innovation

Advanced process design tools and 3D modeling.

### Quality

Stringent QC and fabrication standards.

###### Why Choose Petreco

### Proven Performance. Global Reach. Personal Commitment.

## The better way. The bigger solution.

We don’t stop searching until we’ve found it. That’s how we’re wired and what we love, a diverse
team of experts with a passion for technical mastery and absolute dedication to our craft.

If that’s you, join us.

[Career opportunities][43]
Vanessa Boudreau, PE, MSESenior Project Engineer & PM - Process

> Working at Salas O’Brien has developed my project management skills as much as my technical
> skills. By working closely with clients at different scales and in different contexts, I’ve become
> proficient in a wide spectrum of what the industry can offer process engineers.

Vanessa Boudreau, PE, MSESenior Project Engineer & PM - Process
Srini Neralla, PhDSenior Managing Principal

> The “melting pot” metaphor is well-suited for a company like ours. People, culture, and values are
> very important in our success. We are a collection of strong entrepreneurial-minded leaders that
> collaborate, synergize, and capitalize on one another’s successes and opportunities, and it is
> wonderful learning from each other.

Srini Neralla, PhDSenior Managing Principal
Deb BrittonPrincipal

> We're invested in what we do. We care about our work, and we want to make a difference. It’s not
> just about the technical side. It extends into the personal relationships we build with our
> clients and with each other.

Deb BrittonPrincipal
Donald YoungPrincipal, Senior Construction Manager

> Salas O’Brien is about defining and then expanding what you’re capable of. You’re encouraged to
> find new ways to approach challenges with more efficiency, better interactions, and smarter use of
> technology. You don’t just show up to perform a role here; you’re pushed to grow it.

Donald YoungPrincipal, Senior Construction Manager
Hugh KingPrincipal, Electrical Engineer

> We’re trying to make an impact and change the way things are done. There’s a real presence of mind
> here, taking your time, focusing on the details, and engineering solutions in the best possible
> way. It shows in the work we deliver.

Hugh KingPrincipal, Electrical Engineer

Innovative software for the process industries and the educational institutions which support them –
from a world leader in OTS. Simtronics combines experience and the latest technology to deliver a
proven, progressive, and exciting simulator system.

Your choice of Windows or Cloud-based OTS to fit every need:

A unique combination of sophistication
and ease

The anywhere, any time cloud based
OTS solution

Dynamic Simulator System (DSS) v8 – a unique combination of sophistication and ease.

The DSS is the platform that runs the suite of dynamic, real-time process models, maximizing
customer value by delivering a cost-effective, intuitive, high-fidelity solution. [More][15]

SimCirrus for the Cloud

A next generation SaaS OTS solution providing anywhere, anytime access to Simtronics high fidelity
Process models and tools. [More][16]

Performance Scoring Utilities (PSU) and SimScore

Provides comprehensive and objective trainee evaluation data and allow instructors to monitor and
track operator performance and progress [More][17]

3D Equipment Tutorials

Animated 3D equipment tutorials to teach
process fundamentals.[More][18]

100+ Process Models available in both English and Metric Engineering units for all levels of
training and industries – from entry level or college degree programs all the way up to highly
experienced operators and technicians. [Full Library][19]

REFINING

UPSTREAM

GREEN ENERGY

CHEMICALS

MIDSTREAM

WATER & WASTEWATER

POWER GENERATION

PIPELINES

PHARMA

New dimensions in interactive, immersive training – creating engaging and memorable experiences to
improve training outcomes and retention.

3D Virtual Training

The VFO is an interactive 3D virtual plant developed to help your trainees visualize and understand
the actual plant. [View sample video][20]

Immersive Training Simulator (ITS) –Robust 360° Immersive Training

The ITS is an immersive structure with 360° wraparound sound and vision that takes virtual reality
to the next level. It is the perfect environment to use for group training as it resembles a
real-life plant without the need for heavy or cumbersome equipment. [More][21]

Meta Quest 2/3/Pro

These state-of-the-art immersive headsets deliver interactive training experiences in 3D spaces that
go beyond the physical world. Coming soon

Dynamic training experiences to elevate skills and connect trainees with other users to share
training exercises.

Training Workbooks – you have to see it to believe it

These workbooks use a layered approach that combines hands-on experience with application of
knowledge and theory to ensure competency achievement. [More][22]

Virtual Training Environment – VTE provides learners with a 3D learning environment

The virtual training environment allows you to teach and reinforce the ability to read and interpret
process information and improve the level of process knowledge. [More][23]

Simtronics Training Exercise Library

Simtec is the integration of generic simulation into learning and development activities that
support process operations. Simtec helps users of the Simtronics DSS Dynamic Simulator System with a
library of 250+ training exercises, which are rated by degree of difficulty. [More][24]

COMPANY PROFILE

[Shanghai Tonfeda Energy Science and Technology Co., Ltd.]
Contact Supplier
Shanghai Tonfeda Energy Science and Technology Co., Ltd. is a HVAC energy-saving service company,
providing professional HVAC energy-saving whole solution and HVAC system upgrading service. Our
company focuses on energy saving on building cooling and heating supply, and services that our
company offers are building energy measurement and consumption evaluation; HVAC system retrofitting;
cooling and heating equipment's maintenance, updating and repair.

Our company covers an area of 45,000 square meters, including a building area of 30,000 square
meters. We have fixed assets of over RMB50 million. At present, there are 350 employees in our
company, and engineering technicians account for 20%. Moreover, there are more than 15 professional
senior engineers and graduate students, and 12 senior engineers in our company.

More than twelve technologies have been awarded with patent rights by the China National Patent
Bureau. Our company has set up an improved, efficient quality certification system according to
ISO9001, and possesses strict quality control and testing measurement. We attained the UKAS
certification in 1998, the Norway Classification Societies ISO9001 quality certification in 2004.
With the technical support of energy-saving air-conditioning professors and experts from Shanghai
Tongji University, we are engaged in providing integrated planning and synthetic diagnose solutions
on air-conditioning system, with the application of seamless integration of several advanced
energy-saving technology, and be satisfied with of service for clients.

Our company and American Jinmen company accumulated funds together and then established Sino-America
joint venture - Zhengjiang Jinmen Industry Co., Ltd., which is located at east suburb of Zhenjiang.
As a national high-tech enterprise, with AAA credit standing since 1998, Jinmen company has been
appraised as a "trustworthy unit strictly abiding by contract" for years.

Jinmen company specializes in producing electrostatic desalters. Our main products are AC, AC & DC
electrostatic desalting equipment, DC electrostatic purification equipment,
denitrification-purification equipment and pressure vessels. We are one of the fixed-point
manufactured corporations by Sinopec, CNPC and CNOOC.

According to customers' expectations and oil properties, we can independently provide a complete set
of serviced for customers, such as design, fabrication, testing debugging, start of run, selection
of emulsifier and optimization of process. Electrostatic desalting & dewatering technology of thick
crude oil and deep desalting technology can reach the following indexes. Na+K is less than 1(ppm)
and water content in drain oil is less than 0.3%. This index tallies completely with international
Fuel Oil-Gas Turbine criteria. We have provided 15 sets of deep desalting equipment to our
customers.

We have a team of engineering technicians with exquisite technology and development spirit. Several
experts, who are first engaged in R&D on electrostatic desalting technology all work in our company.

[Shanghai Tonfeda Energy Science and Technology Co., Ltd.]
Contact Supplier
Shanghai Tonfeda Energy Science and Technology Co., Ltd. is a HVAC energy-saving service company,
providing professional HVAC energy-saving whole solution and HVAC system upgrading service. Our
company focuses on energy saving on building cooling and heating supply, and services that our
company offers are building energy measurement and consumption evaluation; HVAC system retrofitting;
cooling and heating equipment's maintenance, updating and repair.

Our company covers an area of 45,000 square meters, including a building area of 30,000 square
meters. We have fixed assets of over RMB50 million. At present, there are 350 employees in our
company, and engineering technicians account for 20%. Moreover, there are more than 15 professional
senior engineers and graduate students, and 12 senior engineers in our company.

More than twelve technologies have been awarded with patent rights by the China National Patent
Bureau. Our company has set up an improved, efficient quality certification system according to
ISO9001, and possesses strict quality control and testing measurement. We attained the UKAS
certification in 1998, the Norway Classification Societies ISO9001 quality certification in 2004.
With the technical support of energy-saving air-conditioning professors and experts from Shanghai
Tongji University, we are engaged in providing integrated planning and synthetic diagnose solutions
on air-conditioning system, with the application of seamless integration of several advanced
energy-saving technology, and be satisfied with of service for clients.

Our company and American Jinmen company accumulated funds together and then established Sino-America
joint venture - Zhengjiang Jinmen Industry Co., Ltd., which is located at east suburb of Zhenjiang.
As a national high-tech enterprise, with AAA credit standing since 1998, Jinmen company has been
appraised as a "trustworthy unit strictly abiding by contract" for years.

Jinmen company specializes in producing electrostatic desalters. Our main products are AC, AC & DC
electrostatic desalting equipment, DC electrostatic purification equipment,
denitrification-purification equipment and pressure vessels. We are one of the fixed-point
manufactured corporations by Sinopec, CNPC and CNOOC.

According to customers' expectations and oil properties, we can independently provide a complete set
of serviced for customers, such as design, fabrication, testing debugging, start of run, selection
of emulsifier and optimization of process. Electrostatic desalting & dewatering technology of thick
crude oil and deep desalting technology can reach the following indexes. Na+K is less than 1(ppm)
and water content in drain oil is less than 0.3%. This index tallies completely with international
Fuel Oil-Gas Turbine criteria. We have provided 15 sets of deep desalting equipment to our
customers.

We have a team of engineering technicians with exquisite technology and development spirit. Several
experts, who are first engaged in R&D on electrostatic desalting technology all work in our company.
More than twelve kinds of technology are developed together, such as deep desalting technology,
double oil entering and electric field technology. They have been awarded with patent rights by the
China National Patent Bureau.

Up to now, our company has supplied more than 800 complete sets of AC or AC & DC and deep
electrostatic desalting equipment for petrochemical companies. They are exported to Sudan and
Kazakhstan. All equipment has achieved technical index which is regulated by the contract, and has
gained high praises and appraisals from customers.

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

#### Power BI Consulting Services: What They Include and Why They Matter

Organizations across industries are investing heavily in business intelligence platforms to improve
decision-making, operational visibility, and data-driven strategy. Microsoft Power BI has emerged as
one of the most widely adopted analytics tools due to its advanced visualization capabilities and
seamless integration with modern data platforms. However, deploying Power BI alone does not
automatically create a scalable analytics environment. Professional Power BI consulting services
help organizations move beyond basic reporting by designing structured analytics systems that
integrate data sources, automate reporting processes, and deliver reliable insights for business
leaders. The Role of Power BI in a Modern Analytics Environment Power BI acts as a bridge between
complex business data and actionable insights. When implemented effectively, it enables
organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.
However, achieving this level of integration requires careful planning, structured data models, and
ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a
Power BI Consulting Engagement A structured engagement typically begins with an assessment of
business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This
discovery phase ensures that the analytics environment aligns with business priorities rather than
simply replicating existing reports. During this stage, consulting teams also evaluate data quality,
integration requirements, and governance policies that may affect implementation. Once the
requirements are defined, consultants begin designing the architecture required to support
dashboards, automated reporting workflows, and scalable analytics models. Core Capabilities
